artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan (6h) making roadmap_batches the primary candidate source for /orchestrate's conclusion-stage next-batch suggestion, with an explicit mechanical fallback and 8 new regression cases.

memory_candidates.content: orchestrate-suggest-next-batch.sh renders its --help by a FIXED line range (usage() does `sed -n '2,94p'` on its own source, at the function's definition site around line 99), so any header documentation added below line 94 is silently absent from --help output unless that range is widened in the same edit. This is a general hazard for every script in agent-system/extensions/core/scripts that implements usage() this way: a header edit and a usage() range edit are one atomic change, and no gate detects the mismatch -- the script still runs, --help still exits 0, and the new documentation simply never prints. Separately: editing any indexed context/** file moves that file's line_count entry in agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json (check-extension-docs.sh Rule R), which deploy-headless.sh auto-repairs; since no pre-commit hook is installed in this repository the check is advisory, so a plan may declare index-entries.json in the phase that moves the count and reconcile it in a later deploy phase.
